sentences.text:
Debolina Sarkar (Ghosh) vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on
9 January, 2025
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 Present:
 The Hon'ble Justice Shampa Dutt (Paul)
 Crr 3982 of 2023
 Debolina Sarkar (Ghosh)
 Vs
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.

For the Petitioner : Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra,
 Mr. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhuri,
 Ms. Madhurai Sinha,
 Mr. Ranabeer Halder.
 For the State : Ms. Sreyoshi Biswas,
 Mr. Trina Mitra.
 Hearing concluded on : 20.12.2024
 Judgment on : 09.01.2025

The present revisional application has been preferred praying for return of articles seized in connection with G.R. Case No. 4836 of 2022, arising out of Chatterjeehat P.S. Case No. 162 of 2022 dated 25.08.2022 under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 & 4 of the D.P.
Act.
2.

It appears from the materials in the case diary that the 'streedhan' articles has been returned to the de facto complainant and, as such, the present revisional application has now become infructuous.
3. Accordingly, the present revisional application being CRR 3982 of 2023 is disposed of as 'infructuous'.
